I will use both manure and a small amount of chemical fertilizer from the cooperative on my sorghum, as the land needs help to produce. I plant local seed saved from last season because it is what I have, and my family will do all the work on this small plot. We do not use sprays or irrigation since water comes from the rain and chemicals cost too much.
